About 5 GB. Create the OBB on a PC, then select it here. Importing creates another copy; keep additional free space equal to the OBB size.
No PC needed. Original files use approximately %1$s GB plus cache. Download size is shown when available.

On your PC, run the OBB builder with your owned Steam game folder. It creates an AVIF OBB of approximately 5 GB. Copy that file to Downloads on this device, then select Import an AVIF OBB. Original and Korean-patched OBBs are detected automatically.
Game data is missing. Please install the game.
Choose your supported Korean patch 1.2 ZIP. Any folder layout is accepted. Allow about 2.5 GB extra space in addition to the ZIP; game files are not downloaded.
Sign in to Steam to download. Your existing offline installation is unaffected.

Using Steam Mobile on this phone and unable to scan its own screen? Display the QR on another device to sign in without entering your Steam account name or password in this app.

1. Tap "%1$s" and note the address.
2. Open it in a browser on a PC, tablet or another phone.
3. Tap "%2$s" on this phone and complete the Steam approval.

Both devices must be on the same local network: the same Wi-Fi, or Ethernet connected to the same router. Guest networks that isolate devices may block the connection.

The QR refreshes automatically. Sharing stops when login completes or is canceled.
